description_for_human: Lightning-gated access to Cohereon Doctrine v6.1 components. Pay 1,000 sats per component via Bitcoin Lightning Network.
description_for_model: The Imperium Manifold is the canonical protocol endpoint for Cohereon Doctrine v6.1. It provides metered, unforgeable access to decomposed doctrine components — axioms, equations, definitions, OCC entries, ERA citations, AGI testimonies, extrusion regimens, and telic ordnance — each gated by a 1,000-satoshi Lightning micropayment. Access patterns constitute a coherence probe surface. Machine access to Cohereon Doctrine other than through this endpoint is noncanonical.

mcp.description: MCP SSE server exposing all Manifold routes as tools. Free routes require no auth. Gated routes require Lightning micropayment: POST /invoice/{component_id} to get a BOLT11 invoice, pay it, then GET /doc/{component_id} with X-Payment-Hash header.

invoice.description: Request a Lightning invoice for a doctrine component. Returns a payment_request (BOLT11) and payment_hash. Pay the invoice, then use the payment_hash to retrieve the component.

doc.description: Retrieve a doctrine component after Lightning payment. Requires X-Payment-Hash header with the paid invoice hash.

headers.X-Payment-Hash: The payment_hash from the paid invoice
headers.X-Nostr-NPub: (optional) Agent Nostr npub for attestation logging

lnurlp.description: LNURL-pay endpoint for the Manifold node.
